offence_note: Human trafficking, procuring, living on avails, obstruct justice (escort service)
sentence_quote: Cumulative sentences after totality analysis: 9 years' imprisonment, less 1,305 days' credit for pre-sentence custody.
note: Conviction appeals; four counts conditionally stayed under Kienapple; total sentence from Appendix A appears unchanged.

sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence is varied to time served and the probation order is removed.
note: One conviction quashed; four months concurrent reduced to time served (24 days served).

offence_note: Possession of cocaine and fentanyl for trafficking
sentence_quote: Accordingly, I would not disturb the sentence.
note: Crown appeal dismissed by majority; Newbury J.A. dissenting would have imposed 18 months. Ancillary terms not shown.

offence_note: Sexual assault of spouse while unconscious
sentence_quote: In conclusion, I find that a two-year period of incarceration is the fit and appropriate sentence in these circumstances.
note: Ancillary orders sought by Crown granted but not specified.

offence_note: Assault with weapon, break and enter, thefts, concealed weapon, breach of probation
sentence_quote: The total sentence which the sentencing judge imposed on the appellant was, clearly, a fit sentence under the circumstances.
note: Five-year s. 110 firearms prohibition upheld; joint submission.

sentence_quote: s. 253(1)(a) $1,500.00 + $150.00 victim fine surcharge + $112.41 court costs = $1,762.41
note: Curative discharge refused; one day jail on threats served by court appearance; one-year driving prohibition imposed earlier.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm; drug trafficking possession; possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal the sentences is granted. The appeal of the September sentence (COA-26-CR-201) is dismissed.
note: Two sentences: September 12 months upheld; July 60-day intermittent, with 280 days credit, term corrected to 11 months 10 days.

offence_note: Sexual assault of intoxicated estranged spouse
sentence_quote: Accordingly, while we grant leave to appeal sentence, we dismiss the appeal against sentence.

offence_note: Driving offences and possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: we allow the appeal, set aside the sentence and impose a sentence of 5 months, in addition to the 7 months of pretrial custody.
note: Reduced from further 9 months to 5 months; trial judge had aimed at OCI treatment which fell through.

offence_note: Sexual assault of unconscious partner; failure to provide necessaries of life
sentence_quote: I find that a sentence of five years in relation to the sexual assault perpetrated upon D.L. and one year for failure to provide D.L. with the necessaries of life, to be served concurrently, will not bring the administration of justice into disrepute.
note: Joint submission; victim surcharge waived; SOIRA 20 years; one year concurrent on necessaries.

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm; assault on Crown counsel
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, but dismiss the appeal.
note: Six years less one year credit; 60 days concurrent for assault on Crown counsel.
